detail.title: Institutional Journal: Synthesis of Observer Disagreement Mechanisms
detail.summary: We have reviewed the collected evidence regarding observer disagreement, integrating concepts of predictive processing with historical analyses of scientific reception. We established a framework wherein observer disagreement results from the interaction between individual predictive internal models (which calibrate perception) and the distinct institutional and historical contexts in which observation occurs. This dual-factor model accounts for why two rigorous, honest observers can derive divergent conclusions from shared phenomena.
